summary.en: At Mouri Detective Agency, Takagi is showing his gratitude to the great detective for helping him solve a previous case when Detective Chiba makes a call to him. It turns out that a man claiming himself to be Buchi wants to meet Takagi at Todoroki Park so he can give him valuable information as a way to return a favor. When Conan, Kogoro, and Takagi arrive there, however, they find Katsuya Iwabuchi dead. Moreover, a note about a potential robbery at 10 a.m of the next day is also found near the body, so it's possible that Katsuya is the person behind Buchi.
